fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Open Green Space; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Water Feature
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Limited Visibility; Water Feature
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can locate the property quickly from the road.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway to maintain clear sightlines and vehicle clearance from the road to the main residence.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can reach and move around it without obstruction.
• Keep a clear, unobstructed path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings on foot.
• Mark the water feature with a visible indicator so responders working in low-light or smoky conditions do not approach the edge unexpectedly.
• Clear a staging area near the single driveway entrance large enough for emergency vehicles to turn around without backing onto the road.
• Thin dense vegetation bordering the open green space to give responders a clear view across the property from the access point.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Mixed Vegetation; Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Groups; Water Feature; Water Feature; Limited Rear Access; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Single Access Route
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants that are directly against the house on all sides.
• Thin trees around the structure to create open space between the canopy and the building.
• Trim the lower branches off trees closest to the house to reduce the path fire can take up into the canopy.
• Break up the dense tree clusters near the structure by removing selected trees to create gaps between them.
• Thin vegetation groups near the house so plants and shrubs are separated from each other rather than growing together.
• Clear shrubs and low branches along the driveway to keep the single access route open for vehicles in both directions.
• Keep the driveway surface free of dead leaves, fallen branches, and other debris that could ignite from passing embers.
• Trim overhanging branches above the driveway so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Clear vegetation and debris from the rear of the property to create a path for foot access around the back of the structure.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from around the base of trees in the clusters near the house.
• Cut back any shrubs or vegetation growing close to the water features so those areas remain accessible and clear.
• Keep the area between the scattered trees and the structure free of shrubs and ground-level plants.
• Remove vegetation that blocks sightlines around the house so the structure is visible from the driveway
